1.en: Then God spoke to Moses, a speaking.

2.en: Command the sons of Israel, and say to them

2.ja: אי רגל או אמראה. סווג' נד'רא נסך
2.en: Any man or woman who has deemed a vow of devotion lawful
2.he: אִישׁ אוֹ-אִשָּׁה כִּי יַפְלִא לִנְדֹּר נֶדֶר נָזִיר

2.en: to practice devotion to his Lord

3.en: from wine and from what is intoxicating he shall practice devotion

3.ja: חתא כ'ל כ'מר. וכ'ל מ'סכר לא ישרב
3.en: such that even vinegar of wine and vinegar of an intoxicating drink he shall not drink
3.he: חֹמֶץ יַיִן וְחֹמֶץ שֵׁכָר לֹא יִשְׁתֶּה

3.en: and every infusion of grapes he shall not drink
and grapes, fresh or dried, he shall not eat.

4.en: All the days of his devotion

4.ja: מן כל מא יעמל מן גפן אלכ'מר
4.en: from everything made from the vine of wine

4.ja: מן אלפרצן אלי' אלזג לא יאכל
4.en: from the seeds to the skin surrounding it — he shall not eat.

5.en: And all the days of the vow of his devotion
no razor shall pass over his head

5.ja: אלי' אן תתם אלאייאם. אלתי תנסכהא לרבה
5.en: until the days he devotes to his Lord are complete

5.ja: יכון מקדסא. וירבי פרע שער ראסה
5.en: he shall be consecrated, and shall grow out the branch of the hair of his head.

6.en: Likewise, all the days of his devotion to God
he shall not enter into the presence of a dead person.

7.en: Not even for his father or his mother, his brother or his sister

7.ja: לא יתנגס בהם פי חאל מותהם
7.en: he shall not defile himself through them at the time of their death
because the devotion to his Lord is upon him.

8.en: Likewise, all the days of his devotion
he is consecrated to his Lord.

10.ja: יאתי בשפנינין. או פרכ'י חמאם. אלי' אלאמאם
10.en: he shall bring two sparrows or two young pigeons to the imām
10.he: יָבִא שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה אֶל-הַכֹּהֵן

10.en: to the entrance of the tent of the assembly.

11.en: And he shall make one of them a purification-offering, and the other a burnt-offering
11.he: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְאֶחָד לְעֹלָה

11.ja: ויסתג'פר ענה. במא אכ'טא פי אמר מיית
11.en: and he shall seek forgiveness for him for what he erred in the matter of the dead person
and his head shall be consecrated at that time.

12.en: And he shall practice devotion to God for the days of his devotion

12.ja: ויאתי. בחמל אבן סנתה לקרבאן אלאתם
12.en: and shall bring a lamb in its first year as a guilt-offering
and the preceding days shall lapse

13.en: And this is the law of the devotee
on the day of the completion of the days of his devotion

13.ja: יאתי בה. אלי' באב כ'בא אלמחצ'ר
13.en: he shall bring him to the entrance of the tent of the assembly.

14.en: And he shall present his offering to God
a lamb in its first year, unblemished, for the burnt-offering
and a ewe-lamb in its first year, unblemished, for the purification-offering
and a ram, unblemished, for the peace-offering.

15.ja: וסלה' פטיר. גראדק סמד מלתותה בדהן
15.en: And a basket of unleavened bread — loaves of fine flour kneaded with oil
15.he: וְסַל מַצּוֹת סֹלֶת חַלֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן

15.en: and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil
and the grain-offering and the libation that goes with them.

16.en: And the imām shall present them before God
and shall make his purification-offering and his burnt-offering.

17.ja: ואלכבש. יצנעה ד'בח סלאמה ללה. מע סלה' אלפטיר
17.en: And the ram he shall make a peace-offering to God, together with the basket of unleavened bread
17.he: וְאֶת-הָאַיִל יַעֲשֶׂה זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהוָה עַל סַל הַמַּצּוֹת

17.ja: ת'ם יצנע אלבר ואלמזאג אלד'י מעה
17.en: then he shall make the grain-offering and the libation that goes with it.

18.ja: ויחלק אלנאסך. ענד באב כ'בא אלמחצ'ר שער ראסה
18.en: And the devotee shall shave the hair of his head at the entrance of the tent of the assembly
18.he: וְגִלַּח הַנָּזִיר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד--אֶת-רֹאשׁ נִזְרוֹ

18.ja: וילקי עלי' אלנאר. אלד'י תחת ד'בח אלסלאמה
18.en: and cast it upon the fire that is under the peace-offering.

19.ja: ויאכ'ד אלאמאם. אלד'ראע מטבוכ'ה מן ד'אלך אלכבש
19.en: And the imām shall take the cooked foreleg from that ram

19.ja: וגרדקה ואחדה מן אלפטיר. ורקאקה ואחדה
19.en: and one loaf from the unleavened bread, and one wafer
19.he: וְחַלַּת מַצָּה אַחַת מִן-הַסַּל וּרְקִיק מַצָּה אֶחָד

19.ja: ויצ'ע ד'אלך עלי' כפי אלנאסך. בעד חלקה שער ראסה
19.en: and shall place them upon the palms of the devotee after he has shaved the hair of his head.
19.he: וְנָתַן עַל-כַּפֵּי הַנָּזִיר אַחַר הִתְגַּלְּחוֹ אֶת-נִזְרוֹ

20.ja: ויחרך אלגמיע תחריכא בין ידי אללה
20.en: And he shall wave all of it as a waving before God
20.he: וְהֵנִיף אוֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה

20.ja: וליכון מקדסא לאלאמאם. מע קץ אלתחריך. וסאק אלרפיעה
20.en: and it shall be consecrated for the imām, together with the breast of waving and the thigh of the raised-offering
20.he: קֹדֶשׁ הוּא לַכֹּהֵן עַל חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְעַל שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה

20.en: and after that the devotee may drink wine.

21.ja: הד'ה שריעה' אלנאסך. קרבאנה ללה ען נסכה
21.en: This is the law of the devotee — his offering to God on account of his devotion
21.he: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַנָּזִיר אֲשֶׁר יִדֹּר קָרְבָּנוֹ לַיהוָה עַל-נִזְרוֹ

21.en: apart from what his hand may obtain

21.ja: וליכון ד'אלך כמקדאר מד'ה נסכה. יצ'מה אלי' שריעה' אלנסך
21.en: and let that be in proportion to the period of his devotion, which he shall add to the law of devotion.
21.he: כְּפִי נִדְרוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִדֹּר--כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה עַל תּוֹרַת נִזְרוֹ

22.en: Then God spoke to Moses, a speaking.

23.en: Command Aaron and his sons and say to them
Thus shall you bless the sons of Israel

25.en: And may He make His face shine toward you

26.en: And may He turn with His purpose toward you

27.en: So that they recite My name over the sons of Israel
